added_steps:
- name: Generate live-input Hybrid workflow reports
        run: python ../scripts/generate_hybrid_workflow_ci_pdfs.py --output hybrid-workflow-pdfs

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7

          name: hybrid-workflow-pdfs-${{ matrix.os }}
